title: Wault Finance — WUSDMASTER Price Manipulation Flash Loan Analysis
root_cause: `stake()` was called 68 times in a single transaction without slippage protection (`minOut = 0`) and without per-block rate limiting, each call executing a USDT→WEX AMM swap; repeated calls cumulatively distorted WEX/USDT reserves, allowing the attacker to profit from WEX price manipulation
vulnerable_contract: WUSDMASTER (WUSD → BUSD redemption and WEX staking)
steps: Step 1: WaultSwap Flash Loan — borrow nearly all WUSD
Step 3: Arbitrage using distorted WEX price
Step 4: Additional profit settlement in PancakeSwap
Step 5: All assets → BUSD conversion + flash loan repay
